_about: Built-in defaults for python3 -m refplane. Edit freely. Per-board overrides go in <board>.refplane.json next to the .kicad_pcb (same keys, any subset); command-line flags override both.

power_nets._about: Supply rails are not signals: routed tracks of these nets are skipped (GND is a reference net anyway). A net named with --nets, or --include-power, is checked anyway.

islands._about: Reference-copper islands under selected traces: floating (error), reached only through a neck or track (warning), tied by fewer than min_ties vias (warning), or trace farther than max_tie_distance_mm from the island's nearest tie via (warning).

stitch._about: Return-via rules for layer changes. A net gets its profile from: 'classes' (any class except Default), then the first matching 'nets' pattern, then 'classes'.Default, then 'default_profile'. A class or pattern may name a profile or give a number (distance in mm, other values from default_profile).
stitch._high_speed_about: Explicit mode: list the high-speed nets (wildcards) and/or net classes here, e.g. ["USB", "Clock", "*ETH_*"]. Then every other net is low speed and the 'nets' name patterns below are not used. Empty list = name-pattern mode.

high_speed.description: clocks, USB, Ethernet, LVDS, DDR, RF: return via close to every signal via; a differential pair may share one

low_speed.description: I2C, UART, SPI, CAN, SWD, GPIO, LEDs: a few signal vias may share one or two return vias
